Parish Envelopes If you use the envelope system for the various church collections, your box of envelopes for 2027 is now available from the Parish Office. A sincere word of thanks to all who support the parish financially whether it is through the envelope system, by placing cash in the collection baskets, and by periodic or annual contributions. Thanks also to those who have signed up for the envelope system following the recent appeal at the weekend Masses. For your information, the offertory collection at the weekend Masses and on the various church holidays goes towards the financial upkeep of the parish on a day-to-day, week-to-week paying the many bills that come our way, just like any household. Forever Loved, Forever Cherished Farranree parish will host a special Service of Remembrance for babies and infants lost during pregnancy or at birth down through the years on Friday, 27th November, at 7.00pm in the Church of the Resurrection, Knockpogue Avenue, Farranree, Cork T23 NV97. Anyone who has experienced the heartache of the loss of an infant or a baby, no matter is welcome to this service as we remember your precious child and honouring their memory in quiet ritual and prayer. Christmas Triduum Mass Cards These cards are now available to buy from the Parish Office. The cost is just €3 – a bargain! This is the same price as 2025, and they have proved to be very popular over the last number of years. As in previous years, the proceeds from the sale of the cards will go to the local conference of the Society of St. Vincent de Paul and also to help with the missionary work of Bishop John Ryan in the diocese of Mzuzu, Malawi. Society of St. Vincent de Paul The local conference helps people in need with a range of supports including food vouchers, fuel for heating, support with domestic bills, guidance, advice and encouragement to access support from the wider SVP network. Volunteers are always needed, so if you feel that you could help with this important work, please contact 087 – 152 0360.

Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat 11th-13th December 2026 Calling all young people aged 16 –35! Join the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. This is a donation-only event, with free buses available across the country and all meals included. Hear inspiring talks and workshops, Mass, music, prayer, and plenty of opportunities to chill out and meet other young Catholics. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome. To register or find out more, visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland." Feast of Christ, Our King Way back in January we began the year by celebrating the Baptism of Jesus when a voice was heard from the clouds calling him‘the beloved Son’. During the year we have greeted Jesus under all the views of him as presented in the gospels. Now today, at the end of the Church’s year, we greet him with the all-embracing title: Jesus Christ, Universal King. Jesus, the Christ is the one who will gather us all together at the end of time, the one who will judge the living and the dead, and then present his kingdom to the Father. In our pilgrimage of faith that kingdom of justice, truth, and peace is to be our beacon, and Christ our guide. But before we join Christ in his banquet, we must ask pardon for the times when we followed other paths and other ways , when we listened to the false prophets of greed and materialism, and for when we have failed to work for the coming of the k ingdom.
